title: Kandoth’s Lab of Plant Stress and Molecular Biology
text:
Kandoth’s Lab of Plant Stress and Molecular Biology
Department of Plant Science | School of Biological Sciences
Central University of Kerala








About the Lab


Our lab focuses on understanding how plants perceive and respond to environmental challenges, particularly under biotic and abiotic stress conditions. A major emphasis of our research is on endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and ER stress-associated programmed cell death pathways in plants.
We integrate molecular biology, genomics, and proteomics approaches to uncover regulatory networks governing cellular homeostasis and stress adaptation. The lab also explores how ER-mediated signaling contributes to plant resilience.
In addition, we employ advanced genome editing strategies to translate fundamental discoveries into practical applications. Notably, our work includes developing nutritionally safe Lathyrus, a climate-resilient legume, contributing to sustainable agriculture and food security.

title: Join us!
text:
We are always looking for motivated and curious researchers to join our lab working on plant stress biology, ER stress pathways, and genome editing.






Interns


Interns are welcome to join the lab and contribute to ongoing research projects in plant stress biology, molecular biology, and genomics. Students will gain hands-on experience in laboratory techniques and data analysis.





PhD Positions


PhD students can pursue independent research within the broad areas of plant stress biology, ER stress, and genome editing. The lab provides access to advanced molecular biology, genomics, and proteomics facilities.



Opportunities to work on cutting-edge plant molecular biology problems


Access to sequencing and bioinformatics resources


Collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment



Interested candidates are encouraged to contact the PI to discuss research interests before applying. Applicants must qualify through the official university selection process and hold valid national-level fellowship scores (CSIR/UGC-NET, GATE, etc.).





Postdoctoral Fellows


We welcome applications from highly motivated postdoctoral researchers with strong backgrounds in plant molecular biology, genomics, or related fields.



Applicants should have a clear research proposal


Strong publication record is preferred


Experience in molecular biology, bioinformatics, or plant physiology is desirable



Candidates are encouraged to contact the PI with their CV and research proposal. Exceptional candidates from interdisciplinary backgrounds are also encouraged to apply.





Contact


Interested candidates can email with CV and research interests.


📧 pramod.kandoth@cukerala.ac.in

title: Research
text:
Overview


The Kandoth Lab focuses on understanding plant responses to environmental stress, with a particular emphasis on endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-associated pathways and their role in maintaining cellular homeostasis and survival under stress conditions.










ER Stress in Plants


We investigate how environmental and developmental cues induce ER stress and how plants maintain protein-folding homeostasis under adverse conditions.








ERAD Pathways


We study ER-associated degradation (ERAD) pathways that identify and remove misfolded proteins, ensuring cellular quality control and stress tolerance.








ER Stress & Programmed Cell Death


We explore how prolonged ER stress triggers programmed cell death and how this process contributes to plant survival and adaptation under extreme conditions.
